response.rationale: The item is a final-sale clearance item (final_sale == True), which triggers RET-012, the highest-priority rule (100). Final-sale items cannot be returned or exchanged. No higher or overriding rule applies: the item is not defective, there is no goodwill grant, and no other applicable rule outranks RET-012. The fact that it was a gift does not affect eligibility.
